# MiniEdit

`miniedit.py` is the Python 3-compatible Mininet example from commit
`d7f399d7a1200b602bd6a95ae88bae1009664d4a` of
https://github.com/mininet/mininet, with local lab fixes for JSON loading,
link ports and GUI/CLI behaviour. Original author credits remain in the file.
See `MININET_LICENSE` for the upstream license.
